text:
Friendly hello all hands,
Last week, the welfare lead mentioned some notes on seating plans

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the same calm, practical standard on every file handled for Aurelia Skyways. When a booking includes live animals, review the paperwork closely, confirm the crate details, and keep the traveler informed in plain language. Handlers should continue to use patient, humane methods, and staff should avoid rushed moves that may unsettle the animal or create confusion at the counter. <<FACT F060>> Please place special care on the handoff sequence so that the animal, the crate, and the documentation stay together from acceptance through release.

The same discipline applies when an itinerary includes a small dog. Check the dimensions, confirm the carrier condition, and make sure the record is complete before the file moves onward. <<FACT F062>> If any detail seems unclear, escalate it at once rather than letting it drift into the queue. Clear notes, steady communication, and consistent follow-through help us protect animal welfare and keep service reliable for both travelers and colleagues.

Please also remember that every journey is a shared responsibility across the desk, the ramp, and the cabin teams. Keep messages concise, accurate, and courteous, and avoid assumptions when a case involves a reptile, a small dog, or any other companion animal. Thank you for keeping standards high and for supporting each other with discipline and care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
